title: Plant Manager
text:
The Plant Manager provides the leadership, management, and vision necessary to ensure operating efficiency and the highest level of customer service. This position is responsible for managing total plant operations and delivering superior customer satisfaction by driving results and exceeding expectations in the key areas of budgeting, compliance, safety programs, and people management.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 7-10 years of Plant leadership experience in automated manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, distribution, or industrial operations
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Demonstrated ownership of site performance metrics
* Strong people leadership and employee engagement capability
* Experience leading safety, quality, cost, service, and productivity outcomes
* Experience with leading multi-disciplinary teams
* Working knowledge of Lean, Continuous Improvement, and operational excellence and ability to apply basic principles to operational execution
* Financial and business acumen or the ability to understand, interpret, and use financial information and business circumstances to drive sound business decisions
* Matrixed environment experience and being able to deliver results with support and alignment from other organizational functions
* Ability to lead a team of both hourly and salaried staff including Direct and Indirect

**Scope/Accountabilities**

* Full site leadership (production, safety, cost, quality, service)
* Translate network priorities into plant execution
* Own plant-level performance results and leadership effectiveness

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own full plant P&L and long-term performance
* Deliver site KPIs (people, safety, quality, DIFOT, cost, productivity)
* Embed standard operation systems and processes
* Drive performance improvement vs. baseline
* Build high-performing frontline leadership teams
* Drive Lean/CI execution
* Manage labor and capacity
* Lead talent development and succession within site
* Networking and representing the organization within the community
* Effective communication with all key stakeholders

**Required Capabilities**

* Strong operational executive & P&L ownership
* Deep operational execution discipline
* Financial ownership at plant level
* Leadership and engagement
* Data driven decision making and performance management
* Working knowledge of automation/engineering environments
